actual_scope: Decide whether the factor 1/W in the normalized child recurrence keeps F(e) below a constant times sqrt(e) when the child list only satisfies 1 <= t < m.
scope_change_reason: The audit names normalization by W as the critical assertion. The transfer review proves the bound only when Psi(tau) < 1.
bottleneck_link: A child list whose Psi exceeds 1 makes the normalized recurrence outgrow every square-root allowance, so dividing by W is not the whole transfer hypothesis.
stop_rule: Use the displayed recurrence. Do not replay a network or open the parking-schedule manuscript.
evidence: Four width-2 children, two roles and modulus 4 give Psi(1/2)^2 = 2 and normalized value 3 at width 8, and 9 > 8. One width-1 child, four roles and modulus 4 gives Psi = 1/8 and stays within allowance 8/7 through width 64.
